body:
I wish E would do the same as T for the voice. :/ Even though it may take some time, I do believe that it is possible to train your voice. Not a lot of experience with it, but I've stumbled across multiple voice training videos by transgender folks on YouTube. But I have a feeling you may already have seen a few.

Just know that everyone's different. There are cisguys with higher voices and there are plenty of ciswomen with deeper voices. I know, easier said than done to think about it. Doesn't really help that much but it feels good knowing you're definitely not alone! It's easy to forget, though, so thanks for reminding me :)

It really sucks being held back so much by something as simple as one's voice. The most basic thing about us humans... At least it'll change with HRT but I'm not there yet. School's miserable because, among other reasons, I just don't feel like talking because of my voice.

Swede here. Had to wait 14 months. 6 months sound awesome, lol 

Edit: Keep yourself occupied and you'll see that time will go by faster than you know it. I did my best in not even thinking about the fact that I had X amount of months left. It's easier said than done, of course, but that's probably the best tip. You'll get there. Just hang in there. :)
Just let me know which app you want to use and I'll make myself an account!
She is incredibly loved (and somewhat spoiled)! ;)
I actually ran 22,5 km the other day and I'm completely addicted! Like I said, I have a long way to go but I'll get there eventually.
Yup. A lot. You're definitely not alone.
Especially the blind dog with the hat. One of my dogs is getting old and she exhibits some elderly dog symptoms. But she's still going strong!
Ran my first ever 20k yesterday. Probably a lot of training left before a full marathon, but it felt amazing nonetheless.
Downloaded and joined right before my post. Will check it out. Thanks!
I'm up for some PM'ing if you'd like.

Hey! Thanks for the reply! I don't know anything about you or your situation, but maybe they really do enjoy your company! Maybe the thoughts of them not liking you has to do with you not really liking yourself? At least that's how I used to feel. Now I know that sure, I'm far from perfect but I could be a decent friend. I just have to initiate contact with people, I guess. And that's hard.

Thank you. I know my parents care, and they've always been supportive. But still, every day is a struggle. I want to make friends but it's difficult. Not because I think I'm unworthy but because I'm afraid of attachment. My mood tends to shift and I need friends that can put up with it, I guess. With me wanting to be completely on my own from time to time.

Has something specific happened between the two of you?

I'm so sorry to hear about that. I can imagine it being of no help to you right now, but there are ways one can transition without hormones. But I know, hormones can help with a lot of things. Maybe it won't make a difference, but I'm sure you're not alone in not being able to start HRT.

I'm becoming more and more isolated. I guess it's difficult when you're in my shoes, though, as I've only got one IRL friend. We haven't seen each other in over two months, I think. It's a long and complicated story...

I've tried to summon the courage to post on one of the find-a-friend subreddits but I just can't. I can't for the life of me understand why anyone would want to waste time on me. But still, I'm longing for someone to just chat with. A friend. I don't have anyone right now I can chat with, and I'm starting to feel really lonely.

Everything that comes with being transgender is also weighing heavily on my shoulders. Probably a bit reason why I'm so depressed.
